caller_agent.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

chain.description: Chains to scan: all (default, Ethereum + Base in parallel), ethereum, or base

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).
